component.name: melo
component.summary: YouTube integrated native desktop music player

description.p: melo is a desktop music player for YouTube and YouTube Music.

ul.li: Search, home feed, mixes and radio from YouTube and YouTube Music
Use the YouTube accounts signed in to your browsers, or guest profiles with their own recommendations
Library and playlists, with offline downloads and local file import
Automatic tagging from MusicBrainz, Deezer and Last.fm
Crossfade, gapless playback and skipping of silent intros and outros
Time-synced lyrics
10-band equaliser and MilkDrop visualiser
16 built-in themes and an extensive theme editor
Customisable player bar and a mini player
Keyboard shortcuts, media keys and MPRIS
Plugins for new music sources, player bar buttons and windows

description.p: melo is in alpha: expect bugs and missing features.

ul.li: Fix some languages and regions, such as English (UK), Hebrew and China, breaking search or falling back to English
Fix a yt-dlp config file changing melo's downloads and cookies
Fix melo ignoring a proxy set in HTTPS_PROXY
Fix YouTube's cookie consent page blocking guests in Europe
Fix the search filters that gave wrong or empty results
Fix importing browser cookies not finding Firefox, breaking Home or missing your YouTube recommendations
Fix Home not loading for new guests
Fix melo crashing on its first start on older systems
Fix titles with HTML tags losing words or turning italic
Fix some titles showing HTML codes instead of their characters
Fix the queue's background changing when it opens in its own window
Add an AppImage that runs on any Linux distribution

description.p: Hotfix for Alpha 3: updated Node.js to 22.23.4, the October 2026 security release.
Hotfix for Alpha 3: fixed blurry artwork in Now Playing.
Hotfix for Alpha 2: fixed playback on Arch-based distributions. Added updates through AppImageUpdate and Gear Lever.
Hotfix for Alpha 2: fixed the full AppImage not opening in AppImage tools.
